double_coset_label: G = PGL_2(q) acting on the q+1 conic parameters; each off-conic intruder centre induces a conic involution. The double-coset label of a (prior triple, reply) pair is the G-orbit of the marked configuration ({sigma_1,sigma_2,sigma_3}, sigma_reply) under simultaneous conjugation; sameness is witnessed by an explicit conjugating g in G.

ej_closeout.ej2_reply_type_equalization: The off-conic-centre pool is UNEQUAL by involution type (145 with 2 fixed points, 128 with 0), yet Y_0 selects exactly 8977 of each type, and each type splits into exactly 1524 Y_NK0 / 7453 non-Y_NK0. Y_0 equalizes an unequal pool and preserves the value split, evidence of an EXTERNAL value-preserving involution on the census that swaps the two reply-involution types (fixed-point count is conjugation-invariant, so the swap is not internal to PGL_2(17)). This is C495's endpoint-swap C2 (det-square class) manifest at q17: value-preserving and acting externally, exactly as at q11.
ej_closeout.note: Exact non-constancy measure at the true double-coset orbit level, the pure sub-domain the global negative conceals, and the reply-involution-type balance.
ej_closeout.reply_type_independent_of_ynk0: reply involutions with 0 vs 2 conic fixed points carry identical (non_ynk0, ynk0) = (7453, 1524) counts: the incidence datum is exactly independent of Y_NK0-membership, the q17 realization of C495's governing C2.

verdict: NON-CONSTANT: the double-coset partition does not refine Y_NK0-membership. Y_NK0 and non-Y_NK0 objects share a double-coset label (explicit PGL_2(17) conjugator), so stratum-constancy fails and the full P/N sweep is skipped. The double-coset label (additive/incidence sort) is orthogonal to Y_NK0-membership (value sort), confirming C495 ej2 at q=17. Stratification is refuted as the bulk-descent mechanism.
